competency_rubric_sliders.descriptor: Flawless term partitioning and zero-pair token proofs.
Precise ruler measurement and column point alignment.
Derived 3w+1 matchstick rule and endless grid coordinates.
Proved vertically opposite angles and linear pairs.
Proved 3x3 magic square center cell 5 and loose leaf odd sums.
Rigorous application of a+b > c theorem.
Mastered Brahmagupta formula and telescoping series 1/n.

project_logs.title: Population Scale & Shortcut Calculator
project_logs.objective: Compare Patna and Mumbai populations and build mental shortcut tables for x5 and x25.
project_logs.self_reflection: Halving and quartering numbers makes multiplying large figures effortless.
project_logs.teacher_feedback: Exceptional mathematical reasoning and place-value clarity.

project_logs.title: Zero-Pair Token Physical Demonstrator
project_logs.objective: Build physical counter model proving a - b = a + (-b).
project_logs.self_reflection: Zero pairs clearly explain why subtracting negative values turns into addition.
project_logs.teacher_feedback: Outstanding conceptual modeling and peer explanation.

project_logs.title: Millimeter Precision Measurement Journal
project_logs.objective: Measure classroom objects in cm and mm and convert paise to rupees.
project_logs.self_reflection: Trailing zeros allow effortless column alignment before subtraction.
project_logs.teacher_feedback: Perfect measurement accuracy and decimal notation.

project_logs.title: Endless 4-Column Matrix Navigator
project_logs.objective: Formulate matchstick rule 3w+1 and map row/col coordinates for number 143.
project_logs.self_reflection: Letter-numbers express complex spatial patterns in simple algebraic formulas.
project_logs.teacher_feedback: Brilliant pattern generalization and coordinate deduction.

project_logs.title: Crease Geometry & Angle Prover
project_logs.objective: Fold square paper to prove angle equality and line parallelism.
project_logs.self_reflection: Crease intersections provide tangible geometric proof of right angles.
project_logs.teacher_feedback: Rigorous geometric proofs and tactile exploration.

project_logs.title: 3x3 Magic Square Center Cell Proof
project_logs.objective: Prove why center cell x must equal 5 for digits 1-9.
project_logs.self_reflection: Summing 4 intersecting lines forces 45 + 3x = 60, proving x = 5.
project_logs.teacher_feedback: Masterful algebraic proof and logical deduction.

project_logs.title: Surveyor Triangular Detour Map
project_logs.objective: Test town mapping feasibility using Triangle Inequality Theorem.
project_logs.self_reflection: Direct distance is always shorter than detour path via a third vertex.
project_logs.teacher_feedback: Superb spatial intuition and theorem validation.

project_logs.title: Brahmagupta Area Grid & Series Canceler
project_logs.objective: Visualize fraction multiplication on 1x1 grid and simplify telescoping series.
project_logs.self_reflection: Cross-cancellation simplifies complex fraction products to 1/n instantly.
project_logs.teacher_feedback: Inspirational historical awareness and mathematical fluency.
